thread:
Devin (sales): Hey team — quick approval ask. HeliosX (fintech) wants a 6-week POC -> 6mo pilot. They’re requesting a 40% introductory concession on hosted usage + a 90-day Dedicated trial (no infra charge). POC kicks off Mon. Need deal desk ok + any legal/security flags. cc @Clem (DealDesk) @Matt - Pricing

Emily S: Flagging: HeliosX will send an updated security questionnaire and wants KMS integration for key management. They also asked about SOC2 + contract SLA.

Matt - Pricing: 40% is larger than our standard pilot concession. What’s the expected committed $ over the 6mo pilot if they convert? Need ARR signal to justify. Any tech blockers that force Dedicated usage?

Devin (sales): They’re projecting $300k ARR if pilot converts, conservative. POC needs higher throughput (long LLM chats + embeddings) so they want Dedicated during pilot to validate latency under load. If we don’t approve Dedicated trial they may opt for a competitor.

Anita Ops: From ops perspective, Dedicated trial is ok with capacity availability, but we need 48h notice to carve GPU pool and a simple runbook for onboarding. Also confirm data residency — they need EU-only.

Lucas CS: I’ll own onboarding and the security questionnaire. Quick note — they requested SSO + SCIM and KMS. We already have SCIM connector ready; KMS may need a minor config.

Clem (DealDesk): Thanks. Two asks before I can sign off: 1) A conditional discount agreement (concession letter) that auto-reverts to standard rate if they don’t hit a minimum $ commit during pilot; 2) Exec approval for >30% discounts. Can we structure it as 35% now, with an incremental rebate to reach 40% if they commit $150k by month 3?

Devin (sales): We can push the $150k convert milestone. Counter-proposal sounds fair to the buyer. They prefer upfront clarity though — prefer 40% straight if we can.

Matt - Pricing: If we do 35% + 5% rebate, we need to ensure tracking and invoice adjustments. Billing can handle a post-pilot credit but legal needs to sign off on the clause. Also need to confirm margin floor on Dedicated GPU costs.

deal-bot: Automated note: pricing exception request logged (ID: PRX-2028-2481239999). Routing to Clem, Matt, Legal.

Clem (DealDesk): I can provisionally approve PRX-2028 for 35% + 5% rebate conditional on: (a) Signed concession letter with milestone clause, (b) Security questionnaire scope accepted by Lucas/Anita, (c) CFO or Sales Leadership ack for the projected $300k ARR. If all green, I’ll sign by EOD.

Emily S: Legal review: I’ll draft the concession letter with auto-revert language and a 30-day invoice credit clause. Also adding EU data residency & KMS appendix.

Lucas CS: I’ll start the security questionnaire now and coordinate KMS details with the customer. ETA 2 business days.

Devin (sales): Thanks — I’ll update customer and lock calendar for onboarding. @Clem let me know if you need anything else for sign-off.

Clem (DealDesk): One more: please include the expected pilot metrics (QPS, avg latency target, token volume) in the concession doc so ops can size Dedicated pool.

Devin (sales): Adding metrics: target QPS 120, p95 latency < 200ms, monthly token usage ~120M. Will include in the doc.

Clem (DealDesk): Perfect. If legal and security confirm within 48h, I’ll approve PRX-2028 subject to CFO ack. :thumbsup:
